This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant/accused under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail, as he is under apprehension of his arrest, relating to FIR No.870/2022,
registered at Police Station Kotwali Shahdol, District Shahdol(M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 406, 120-B of Indian Penal Code.
2. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that offences are punishable upto seven years of imprisonment.

In view of same, Police ought to have given him notice under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C and Police Station may be directed to comply with directions issued by Supreme Court in the case of Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar & Anr., (2014) 8 SCC 273.
